by: Claude Opus 5.5, in a working session on 13 October 2026, from each shot's 8 frames spread across the clip (and its transcript where there is one)
how: the frames were looked at in order, as a strip; what happens, what changes, and whether the editor's one-frame reading survives were written down. Not yet a lab layer; a demonstration of the pass.

21171e70-f59f-55b6-85c3-29691c97e312.happens: A dense flock moves across a hillside meadow; a dark sheepdog works the edge of the flock while a shepherd stands at the treeline; a white flash of film damage; then a different shot of sheep grazing on bare ground.
21171e70-f59f-55b6-85c3-29691c97e312.changes: the dog moves, the flock moves with it; at least one cut
21171e70-f59f-55b6-85c3-29691c97e312.why: the dark animal is a sheepdog, not a stray sheep: it is what keeps the pattern, not what breaks it

7ad22207-8c29-5be6-af5c-3baae38dec31.happens: A storm over a plain; cracked dry earth; a 1934 duck stamp; men buying stamps at a post office counter; a sky full of migrating birds.
7ad22207-8c29-5be6-af5c-3baae38dec31.changes: five shots in one clip: drought, stamp, purchase, birds, an argument in montage
7ad22207-8c29-5be6-af5c-3baae38dec31.why: read from the stamp alone; the clip is a sequence whose sense is the turn from drought to birds

95f7caf3-000b-507c-b163-c862aece09e2.happens: A Dutch intertitle, 'De verpakking vraagt niet minder zorg' (the packaging needs no less care); then, in an iris, hands packing chocolates into a decorated box.
95f7caf3-000b-507c-b163-c862aece09e2.changes: a title card, then one shot of handwork
95f7caf3-000b-507c-b163-c862aece09e2.why: the hands pack many pieces into a box; the thumbnail the lab read was the intertitle

10fe67d6-3449-5fb7-97d8-709a0d297de0.happens: A view through a rock window onto hoodoos with tiny figures below; riders on horseback against clouds; a rider beside a rock tower; a man on a horse seen close from below.
10fe67d6-3449-5fb7-97d8-709a0d297de0.changes: several shots of a guided ride
10fe67d6-3449-5fb7-97d8-709a0d297de0.why: read as cowboys driving cattle; no cattle appear in these frames

c1613029-4190-51f7-a98b-304aed511307.happens: A biplane flies straight at the camera, low over a crop field, dust trailing.
c1613029-4190-51f7-a98b-304aed511307.changes: one continuous approach; the plane grows in the frame

3b4530d3-83e3-56e7-a9d7-fd17e8eaf94c.happens: Snow geese lift off the water together; cranes stand in the shallows; the sky fills with birds in flight.
3b4530d3-83e3-56e7-a9d7-fd17e8eaf94c.changes: three shots; the lift-off is the gesture
3b4530d3-83e3-56e7-a9d7-fd17e8eaf94c.why: stronger in motion than in the frame

5a520bd0-1a20-5bf3-a587-178ee8f1cd0a.happens: A ballot box; the Winter Palace; a chandeliered hall; a Leonardo Madonna; sailors in a gallery; a truck in the street; a stadium filling with people.
5a520bd0-1a20-5bf3-a587-178ee8f1cd0a.changes: a travelogue montage of at least seven shots
5a520bd0-1a20-5bf3-a587-178ee8f1cd0a.why: read as one palace interior; the clip moves from votes to art to sport

9618a9e0-6155-5125-8e6a-99e249d9f5c9.happens: A numbered slate; a procession of people carrying loads walks along a forest road toward and past the camera; cyan leader at the end.
9618a9e0-6155-5125-8e6a-99e249d9f5c9.changes: one shot of a procession, framed by a slate and the end of the reel
9618a9e0-6155-5125-8e6a-99e249d9f5c9.why: the procession comes out of the forest toward us rather than being swallowed by it

764af7c9-b7d5-57f7-af55-d8151872c2ca.happens: Street lamps glow; the neon of a bus depot at night; 'THE END' lights up.
764af7c9-b7d5-57f7-af55-d8151872c2ca.changes: two shots, then the film's end title
764af7c9-b7d5-57f7-af55-d8151872c2ca.why: the night light is there; the shot is also the film's last
